accepted_plan.summary: Remove redundant Workspace Dashboard title/actionbar key hints and selected-row textual status display while preserving row selection markers and Dashboard keyboard/action semantics, updating render tests accordingly.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates TUI tests, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
